concept.material: brushed titanium and forged carbon fibre
concept.button: a small sapphire-tipped push button on the front face
concept.shell_mechanic: The carbon fibre block splits along its diagonal titanium seams and the two halves slide apart horizontally

concept.internal_detail: spiral spring coils and escapement wheels
concept.shell_mechanic: The fluted brass dome divides evenly into eight radial segments that drop outward like petals
concept.emerging_parts: A cluster of thin trailing copper filaments and a central translucent bell
concept.signature_move: its porcelain centre lights up with a warm yellow glow, and its peripheral brass segments pulse outward and inward once on their hinges
